inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> Interior of a small modest rented room in a northern Chinese city in the 2010s, pale cool daylight from a window with a thin white curtain, a small folding dining table with two wooden chairs, a low cabinet against the back wall with a stack of ceramic bowls, a small pot steaming on a single burner, a thermos on the table, matching the reference <Picture 2>. A young Chinese woman in her mid-twenties with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 1>, black hair tied back loosely, wearing a pale grey button-up shirt over a white tee and dark trousers. At the start of the shot she stands beside the small dining table; on the table there is exactly one ceramic bowl with a pair of chopsticks laid beside it, and only one bowl. A paper shopping bag holding new bowls sits on the near chair. Over the course of the shot, in one continuous slow gentle sequence: she turns slightly toward the chair, reaches into the paper bag with her right hand and takes out one ceramic bowl; she brings the bowl to the table and places it down on the table top beside the first bowl, so that two bowls sit side by side on the table; then she stays standing by the table, lowers her head a little and looks at the two bowls side by side, her hands resting near the table edge, quiet and still. By the end of the shot the two bowls remain side by side on the table, she is still standing beside the table looking down at them, her posture relaxed, nothing in her hands. Throughout the shot the room, the window, the chairs and the cabinet stay in the same positions, the bowls never float in the air and never disappear, exactly two bowls on the table at the end and one at the start, her feet stay on the floor, no sudden movement, no sitting down, no other person appears. The young woman has a clear detailed face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 1>. Pale cool daylight from the window with soft shadows and a faint warm bounce.
